title: SpecMaker common definitions
description: Shared primitives for the SpecMaker JSON representation. A spec document is a flat, relational encoding of the SpecMaker.DomainModel DSL: every entity is an object in a top-level collection, carries a document-unique `id`, and expresses each DSL `belongs_to(:assoc)` as an `assoc_id` reference to another object's `id`. The implicit `belongs_to(:spec)` on every entity is omitted because the whole document is one Spec.

Id.description: A document-unique identifier for this object. Author-assigned; referenced by *_id fields on other objects. Uniqueness and referential integrity are conventions this schema cannot enforce structurally.

Ref.description: A reference to the `id` of another object in this document (an encoded `belongs_to` foreign key).
